headline: Parents arrested for killing daughter in Dhaka over relationships
summary: The couple allegedly murdered their daughter and hid her body in a sack to cover up the crime.
details: A father and mother have been arrested in Dhaka for the alleged murder of their daughter.
The parents reportedly killed the girl because she was involved in romantic relationships with multiple men.
Following the murder, the couple allegedly stuffed the victim's body into a sack to hide the evidence.
Police have taken the couple into custody as investigations continue into the crime.
caption:
Parents arrested for allegedly killing their daughter and hiding her body in a sack over her romantic relationships.

A father and mother have been arrested in Dhaka for the alleged murder of their daughter.

The parents reportedly killed the girl because she was involved in romantic relationships with multiple men.

Following the murder, the couple allegedly stuffed the victim's body into a sack to hide the evidence.

Police have taken the couple into custody as investigations continue into the crime.

caption:
Why are US immigrant visas for Bangladeshis suspended? The US Embassy in Dhaka has finally spoken.

The US Embassy in Dhaka has provided an explanation regarding the suspension of immigrant visa services for Bangladeshi applicants.
